title: CHAPTER 029 - Final accept v3.6 and close migration
description: Complete automated acceptance chapter. Verifies the active runtime is the exact v3.6 candidate, production state persisted Chapter 027 as SUCCESS, Chapter 027 post-finalize verifier reported PASS_NO_RETRY, and the live log contains No new task for 027. Backs up state/log/runner and migration artifacts, writes a durable ACCEPTED marker using safe line-by-line report construction, retires stale migration helper/verifier artifacts after backup, and re-verifies runtime, hash, state continuity and cleanup. No manual PowerShell required.
backup: $ErrorActionPreference='Stop'; $root='C:/3EN-Agent'; $stamp=Get-Date -Format 'yyyyMMdd-HHmmss'; $bk=$root+'/backups/029/'+$stamp; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $bk|Out-Null; foreach($name in @('3en-agent-runner-v3.6.ps1','3en-agent.state.json','3en-agent.log','chapter-027-v36-validation.txt','chapter-027-postfinalize.txt','verify-027-finalize.ps1','verify-026-finalize.ps1','switch-to-v36-020a2.ps1','switch-to-v36-022.ps1','switch-to-v36-024.ps1','switch-to-v36-025.ps1')){$src=$root+'/'+$name;if(Test-Path -LiteralPath $src){Copy-Item -LiteralPath $src -Destination ($bk+'/'+$name) -Force}}; Set-Content -LiteralPath ($root+'/chapter-029-backup-path.txt') -Encoding UTF8 -Value $bk; Write-Host ('BACKUP_ROOT='+$bk); Write-Host 'CHAPTER_029_BACKUP=PASS'
script: $ErrorActionPreference='Stop'; $root='C:/3EN-Agent'; $runner=$root+'/3en-agent-runner-v3.6.ps1'; $stateFile=$root+'/3en-agent.state.json'; $logFile=$root+'/3en-agent.log'; $post=$root+'/chapter-027-postfinalize.txt'; $report=$root+'/chapter-029-v36-acceptance.txt'; $accepted=$root+'/3en-agent-v3.6.ACCEPTED.txt'; $expected='57233841FF0F7F6BF78E5EBEB77D0ECCDC2EA07634A81595F31E88B85E8B4B54'; Write-Host '=== READ / EVIDENCE ==='; $self=Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -Filter ('ProcessId='+$PID) -ErrorAction Stop; $isV36=($self.CommandLine -like '*3en-agent-runner-v3.6.ps1*'); Write-Host ('CURRENT_PID='+$PID); Write-Host ('CURRENT_RUNNER_IS_V36='+$isV36); if(-not $isV36){throw 'Active runner is not v3.6'}; $hash=(Get-FileHash -LiteralPath $runner -Algorithm SHA256).Hash; Write-Host ('V36_SHA256='+$hash); if($hash -ne $expected){throw 'v3.6 hash mismatch'}; $tok=$null;$err=$null;[System.Management.Automation.Language.Parser]::ParseFile($runner,[ref]$tok,[ref]$err)|Out-Null; Write-Host ('V36_SYNTAX_ERROR_COUNT='+@($err).Count); if(@($err).Count -ne 0){throw 'v3.6 syntax invalid'}; if(-not(Test-Path -LiteralPath $stateFile)){throw 'production state file missing'}; $state=Get-Content -LiteralPath $stateFile -Raw|ConvertFrom-Json; Write-Host ('STATE_LAST_EXECUTED_ID='+$state.lastExecutedId); Write-Host ('STATE_LAST_TERMINAL_STATUS='+$state.lastTerminalStatus); if($state.lastExecutedId -ne '2026-09-09-028'){throw ('Expected state ID 028, got '+$state.lastExecutedId)}; if($state.lastTerminalStatus -ne 'FAILED_SCRIPT'){throw ('Expected terminal FAILED_SCRIPT for 028, got '+$state.lastTerminalStatus)}; if(-not(Test-Path -LiteralPath $post)){throw 'Chapter 027 post-finalize report missing'}; $postText=Get-Content -LiteralPath $post -Raw; Write-Host '--- POSTFINALIZE 027 ---'; Write-Host $postText; if($postText -notmatch 'POSTFINALIZE_RESULT=PASS_NO_RETRY'){throw '027 post-finalize did not prove PASS_NO_RETRY'}; if($postText -notmatch 'NO_NEW_027_COUNT_TAIL=([1-9][0-9]*)'){throw '027 post-finalize lacks No new task evidence'}; $logTail=''; if(Test-Path -LiteralPath $logFile){$logTail=(Get-Content -LiteralPath $logFile -Tail 200|Out-String)}; $noNew27=([regex]::Matches($logTail,'No new task. ID=2026-09-09-027')).Count; $noNew28=([regex]::Matches($logTail,'No new task. ID=2026-09-09-028')).Count; Write-Host ('LOG_NO_NEW_027_COUNT='+$noNew27); Write-Host ('LOG_NO_NEW_028_COUNT='+$noNew28); if($noNew27 -lt 1){throw 'live log does not contain No new task for 027'}; Write-Host '=== CONCLUSION ==='; Write-Host 'V36_RUNTIME=PASS'; Write-Host 'V36_STATE_FINALIZATION=PASS'; Write-Host 'V36_NO_RETRY=PASS'; Write-Host 'V36_ACCEPTANCE_PRECHECK=PASS'; Write-Host '=== ONE LOGICAL CHANGE: ACCEPT + RETIRE MIGRATION ARTIFACTS ==='; $acceptLines=New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[string]; [void]$acceptLines.Add('3EN_AGENT_V36=ACCEPTED'); [void]$acceptLines.Add('ACCEPTED_AT='+(Get-Date -Format 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss')); [void]$acceptLines.Add('RUNNER_SHA256='+$hash); [void]$acceptLines.Add('VALIDATED_TASK=2026-09-09-027'); [void]$acceptLines.Add('VALIDATED_TERMINAL_STATUS=SUCCESS'); [void]$acceptLines.Add('POSTFINALIZE_RESULT=PASS_NO_RETRY'); [void]$acceptLines.Add('ACTIVE_PID='+$PID); Set-Content -LiteralPath $accepted -Encoding UTF8 -Value $acceptLines.ToArray(); $reportLines=New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[string]; [void]$reportLines.Add('=== CHAPTER 029 V3.6 ACCEPTANCE ==='); foreach($line in $acceptLines){[void]$reportLines.Add($line)}; Set-Content -LiteralPath $report -Encoding UTF8 -Value $reportLines.ToArray(); $patterns=@('switch-to-v36-020a2.ps1','switch-to-v36-022.ps1','switch-to-v36-024.ps1','switch-to-v36-025.ps1','verify-026-finalize.ps1','verify-027-finalize.ps1'); $stale=@(Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue|Where-Object{$_.CommandLine -and ($patterns|Where-Object{$_.CommandLine -like ('*'+$_+'*')})}); foreach($p in $stale){if($p.ProcessId -ne $PID){Stop-Process -Id $p.ProcessId -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Write-Host ('RETIRED_STALE_PROCESS_PID='+$p.ProcessId)}}; foreach($name in $patterns){$p=$root+'/'+$name;if(Test-Path -LiteralPath $p){Remove-Item -LiteralPath $p -Force -ErrorAction Stop; Write-Host ('RETIRED_FILE='+$name)}}; Write-Host 'V36_ACCEPTED_MARKER_WRITTEN=TRUE'
test: $ErrorActionPreference='Stop'; $root='C:/3EN-Agent'; $accepted=$root+'/3en-agent-v3.6.ACCEPTED.txt'; $stateFile=$root+'/3en-agent.state.json'; $runner=$root+'/3en-agent-runner-v3.6.ps1'; $expected='57233841FF0F7F6BF78E5EBEB77D0ECCDC2EA07634A81595F31E88B85E8B4B54'; Write-Host '=== TEST / FINAL EVIDENCE ==='; if(-not(Test-Path -LiteralPath $accepted)){throw 'ACCEPTED marker missing'}; $a=Get-Content -LiteralPath $accepted -Raw; if($a -notmatch '3EN_AGENT_V36=ACCEPTED'){throw 'ACCEPTED marker invalid'}; Write-Host 'ACCEPTED_MARKER=PASS'; $self=Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -Filter ('ProcessId='+$PID) -ErrorAction Stop; if($self.CommandLine -notlike '*3en-agent-runner-v3.6.ps1*'){throw 'current runtime is not v3.6'}; Write-Host ('ACTIVE_V36_PID='+$PID); $hash=(Get-FileHash -LiteralPath $runner -Algorithm SHA256).Hash; if($hash -ne $expected){throw 'v3.6 hash changed'}; Write-Host 'V36_HASH_STILL_MATCHES=PASS'; $state=Get-Content -LiteralPath $stateFile -Raw|ConvertFrom-Json; if($state.lastExecutedId -ne '2026-09-09-028' -or $state.lastTerminalStatus -ne 'FAILED_SCRIPT'){throw 'state continuity changed before 029 finalization'}; Write-Host 'PRE_029_STATE_CONTINUITY=PASS'; $patterns=@('switch-to-v36-020a2.ps1','switch-to-v36-022.ps1','switch-to-v36-024.ps1','switch-to-v36-025.ps1','verify-026-finalize.ps1','verify-027-finalize.ps1'); $left=@(Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue|Where-Object{$_.CommandLine -and ($patterns|Where-Object{$_.CommandLine -like ('*'+$_+'*')})}); Write-Host ('STALE_MIGRATION_PROCESS_COUNT='+$left.Count); if($left.Count -ne 0){throw 'stale migration process remains'}; foreach($name in $patterns){if(Test-Path -LiteralPath ($root+'/'+$name)){throw ('stale migration file remains: '+$name)}}; Write-Host 'MIGRATION_ARTIFACTS_RETIRED=PASS'; Write-Host 'CHAPTER_029_RESULT=V36_STABLE_ACCEPTED'; Write-Host 'MIGRATION_V35_TO_V36=CLOSED'
rollback: $ErrorActionPreference='Continue'; $root='C:/3EN-Agent'; $ptr=$root+'/chapter-029-backup-path.txt'; if(Test-Path -LiteralPath $ptr){$bk=(Get-Content -LiteralPath $ptr -Raw).Trim(); Write-Host ('ROLLBACK_BACKUP_ROOT='+$bk); Write-Host 'Rollback is intentionally manual-by-agent only if acceptance test fails; current runner/state are not replaced by this chapter.'}else{Write-Host 'Backup pointer missing; no automatic rollback attempted.'}
